We are updating several medical policies. Please review the changes and effective dates outlined here: MPC May 2025 Updated Medical Policies Medical Policy: III.158 Total Ankle Replacement Effective Date: 08/01/2025 Preauthorization Required: Yes Policy Statement: Starting 08/01/2025 Interqual criteria will be utilized. Medical Policy: III.243 Orthognathic Surgery Effective Date: 08/01/2025 Preauthorization Required: Yes Policy Statement: Starting 08/01/2025 Interqual criteria will be utilized. Additional codes being added to this policy: 21050, 21210, 21215, 21244, 21299, 21685 Access to Interqual criteria can be found at BCBSNE Provider Procedures . Medical Policy: III.232 Nerve Blocks and Ablation of Peripheral Nerves to Treat Pain Effective Date: 08/15/2025 Preauthorization Required: Yes Policy Statement: Genicular nerve block is considered investigational for all indications.
